plan: Trim SPY to 20% to reduce concentration and meet mandate limits.
Add to QQQI, bringing it to 20%, for increased income and broad market exposure.
Sell QQQ and SMH entirely as they are below their stops and reduce risk.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets approximately 1.5% per month, prioritizing capital preservation. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns, but also more modest growth potential.

moves.note: Scanner sell signal, take some profit

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to align with mandate and reduce concentration.
Add to QQQI, bringing it to 15%, for a balanced income and broad market exposure.
Sell QQQ and SMH entirely due to being below their stops, reducing overall risk.
Trim CRWD to 5% to take some profit while maintaining a smaller position.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for approximately 2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It seeks a blend of broad market exposure and quality tech with reduced leverage, expecting moderate drawdowns.

plan: Trim SPY to 20% to meet mandate and free up capital for higher growth opportunities.
Trim QQQI to 5% to reduce income focus and shift towards aggressive growth.
Sell QQQ and SMH entirely as they are below their stops, reallocating capital.
Add to CRWD, bringing it to 10%, leveraging its strong P&L and re-entering on strength.
Sell METU to follow the trim signal and reallocate capital to stronger setups.
Add to MSFU, bringing it to 5%, to increase leveraged AI exposure on strength.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets approximately 4% per month, aiming for stretch growth. It involves higher concentration and leveraged ETFs, which can lead to significantly larger drawdowns and daily decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Trim SPY to 20% to meet mandate and reduce broad index exposure.
Add to QQQI, bringing it to 40%, to maximize income and make it a core holding.
Sell QQQ and SMH entirely as they are below their stops, reducing growth exposure.
Sell CRWD to follow the scanner's sell signal and reduce high-beta tech.

income.read: This income plan targets approximately 1% per month, prioritizing steady monthly distributions. While aiming for low drawdown, NAV can still fall in a selloff, and distributions are variable, not guaranteed.
